captions.caption: A person hammers a piece of glowing metal on an anvil.
The person strikes the metal again with the hammer.
The blacksmith continues shaping the metal piece on the anvil.
The person uses a hammer to flatten the metal piece.
The metal is struck repeatedly to achieve the desired shape.
The person continues hammering the metal on the anvil.
The person uses tongs to hold a metal piece.
The person dips the hot metal into a hole filled with water in the sand.
Steam rises as the hot metal is quenched in the water.
The person continues to cool the metal piece in the water.
The metal piece is moved around in the water with tongs.
The person holds the metal piece submerged in the water hole.
The person continues the quenching process for the metal.
The person uses tongs to manipulate the metal in the water.
The metal piece is finally cooled and ready.
A close-up shows two finished metal fire strikers on an anvil.
A person's soot-covered hands adjust the fire strikers.
The person picks up one of the fire strikers.
The person examines the small, curved metal piece.
The person places the fire striker back on the anvil.
The hands move the metal pieces to show their shape.
The person picks up the smaller of the two strikers.
The person holds the striker between their thumb and index finger.
The fire striker is shown clearly against the anvil.
The person continues to handle the metal pieces.
A wide shot shows a person walking on a beach towards the background.
The person walks along the shore, carrying a bundle of sticks.
The person walks further away along the coastline.
The person continues walking on the pebbly beach.
The person bends down to pick up more firewood.
The person stands up and keeps walking.
The person continues collecting wood on the beach.
The person walks further into the distance.
The person stops and looks at the ground.
The person continues their walk along the shore.
A person uses tongs to hold a bundle of dry grass.
The person strikes a fire striker against flint to create sparks.
Sparks land on the dry grass bundle held by the tongs.
The person continues striking the flint to ignite the grass.
More sparks are directed into the grass bundle.
The person sets down the fire striker and flint.
The person uses their hands to fold the grass over the sparks.
The person begins to blow gently on the grass bundle.
Smoke starts to rise from the dry grass.
The person continues blowing to encourage a flame.
A small campfire burns on the beach with the ocean in the background.
A person in the background walks towards the water's edge.
The fire in the foreground crackles as the person enters the water.
The person bends down in the shallow water.
The fire continues to burn steadily on the shore.
The person in the background searches for something in the water.
The ocean waves gently lap at the shore behind the fire.
The person remains at the water's edge.
The fire continues to burn brightly.
A close-up shows a person's hands picking up a stone from the water.
The person examines the stone they found in the shallow water.
The person turns the stone over to look at it closely.
The person holds the stone and continues to inspect it.
The person walks out of the water towards the beach.
The person walks along the shore with the stone in their hand.
